messages:
maria: FYI I'm seeing a bunch of errors from our infra tests where the new `x-rw-route-hint` header is missing from requests coming from older SDKs. It looks like the server returns 422 in some routing paths.
kevin: Hmm that's expected if we tightened server-side validation. Are we sure older SDKs will keep sending the old header name? We didn't follow a strict deprecation path.
sara: Right — py/ts/go clients behave differently. Go client currently strips unknown headers in our http helper, py leaves them through, ts depends on fetch polyfills.
maria: I want a safe short-term fallback on the server so older SDKs don't see errors, but we also need telemetry to know when fallback happens.
oliver: Suggestion: accept missing `x-rw-route-hint` and apply "header-fallthrough" routing policy server-side. Emit a telemetry tag `routing.fallback=header_missing` and increment a metric. That keeps behavior backward compatible.
josh: +1 for fallback metric. We should also return a non-500 response header so SDKs can log deprecation warnings client-side, e.g. `X-Redwood-Routing-Warn: fallback-applied;deprecated-header`
maria: I like that. We need to decide exact semantics: 1) server will look for `x-rw-route-hint` then legacy `x-rw-route` then fall back to policy table. 2) If fallthrough used, set telemetry tag and add warning header.
kevin: Can we make the fallback opt-out behind a feature flag for a month so we can roll it out to prod gradually? We don't want to flip it company-wide until SDKs ship updates.
sara: Yes, we can gate with ff: "sdk-header-fallback-v2". Console can show rollout percentage. Ops can increment slowly.
oliver: For SDKs, plan: Py and TS will add explicit warning logs when they see `X-Redwood-Routing-Warn` in responses and surface to customers during development. Go will change its http helper to preserve unknown headers and also log. We should publish a deprecation note with code examples.
josh: Example server pseudo-config:```yamlroutes: - match: header x-rw-route-hint present -> use route-hint-xxx - match: header x-rw-route present -> legacy-route - default: compute-route-from-account```
maria: Tests required: unit for header precedence, integration test where client doesn't send new header and we verify metric `routing.fallback.header_missing` increments, and e2e with canary traffic.
oliver: Also ensure the console dashboard shows the fallback metric and a small UX card under "Routing" that explains what fallback means and links to migration docs.
kevin: Who owns the SDK bits? sara for py/ts, oliver for go?
sara: I'll take py and ts. I'll add a small PR to py-sdk that checks response header and logs once per process with: `logger.warning("Redwood routing header missing; fallback applied. Upgrade to SDK >= v2.1.0")`
oliver: I'll change go-http helper to stop dropping unknown headers and add a utils package function `RedwoodWarnHeaderFrom(resp)` that returns the header string so projects can opt in to logging.
josh: Can we include a small example in the deprecation doc showing the warning header:```HTTP/1.1 200 OKX-Redwood-Routing-Warn: fallback-applied;deprecated-header```
kevin: Timeline: enable FF in staging tomorrow, run 24h, enable 10% in prod next week, watch metrics for spike in fallback, continue to 50% then 100% over 3 weeks. SDK releases should be out by week 2 of rollout.
maria: Good. I'll open a tracking ticket and add the rollout plan. One more ask: add a histogram tag so we can correlate latency changes when fallback is used. `routing.fallback.latency_bucket` or similar.
oliver: Added in infra note. Also add an alert if fallback rate > 5% for more than 2 hours on stable regions.
sara: I'll put together PRs for py/ts today and link to the tracking ticket. Also draft the deprecation email template for customers.
josh: sdk-bot: created issue RED-1427 for server-side fallback + telemetry, assigned to kevin.
sdk-bot: [automated] Issue RED-1427 created: "Server fallback and telemetry for missing x-rw-route-hint". Link: https://redwood.internal/issues/RED-1427
maria: Thanks team. Let's sync in the 11am standup if any blockers.
